title: 初三四材料：午餐与小船
source_notice: 初三公开普通期末转载完整题面/印本脚本/参考键已核，原音轨明确缺；地域学年学期只在标题，正文只见九年级英语，原校认证未建立，不当gold。本稿完整原创配套不补平原录音缺口。
timing_notice: 每段两遍；原卷未印精确停顿，本机听前后每题5秒及重播提示属审阅编排
instruction: 听四段材料，依次回答1—2、3—4、5—7、8—10题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。第三段为独白，其他为对话。每段两遍；本机按每题前后5秒留时，不冒充原卷未印时序。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The new school lunch menu looks good, but why is there no hot soup on Fridays?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The kitchen uses that time to clean the large soup cooker. We can have baked potatoes instead.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I see. Can we still get soup on Thursdays?

questions.stem: Why is soup not served on Fridays?
questions.rationale: A：未缺蔬菜；B：未说厨师缺勤；C：明确清洗大汤锅

questions.stem: What can students have instead on Fridays?
questions.rationale: A：明确替代烤土豆；B：未给冷饭；C：未给果糕

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I want to help with the animal shelter, but I cannot visit every weekend.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: You could help update its website from home. They need someone to put up new photos of the cats.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I am good with computers. Do I need to take the photos too?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: No, the staff will send them to you. I can introduce you to the manager after school.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Thanks. That sounds like a job I can manage.

questions.stem: What can the boy help with?
questions.rationale: A：未建笼；B：明确从家更新网站；C：未开车
A：未提家人拍；B：未提老师拍；C：明确staff send photos

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: Students in our boat-building group have finished a small wooden boat. The project began in September, when a retired boat builder offered to teach us. We met after school every Wednesday. None of us had used a saw before, so our first lesson was about using tools safely. The wood came from an old garden shed that was being taken down. We checked every board and removed all the nails before using it. Next Saturday, we will test the boat on the lake. Only our adult teacher will be in the boat for the first test. Families may watch from the path, but the landing stage will be kept clear.

questions.rationale: A：无体育教练；B：明确退休造船者；C：无记者

questions.stem: What was the first lesson about?
questions.rationale: A：首课不是上漆；B：未选名；C：因未用过锯先学安全工具

questions.stem: Where did the wood come from?
options: A fallen tree in the park.
questions.rationale: A：明确拆除旧棚木料；B：不是新买家具木；C：未取倒树

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: How are you getting on with the walking tour for the exchange students?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I have chosen the places, but the route is too long. It takes nearly three hours.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: They only have two hours before lunch. Could you leave out the castle?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes. It is the farthest stop. Then we can spend more time by the canal.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Good idea. The old lock is interesting.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I will draw a shorter route on the map tonight. Can you check the street names?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Of course. And mark a place where the group can fill their water bottles.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: There is a public tap beside the canal cafe. I will add that.

questions.stem: What is the problem with the original route?
questions.rationale: A：已选景点未说无趣；B：三小时超午餐前两小时；C：未封路

questions.stem: Which stop will they leave out?
questions.rationale: A：保留运河并增加时间；B：咖啡馆旁水龙头被加到图中；C：明确删最远城堡
A：男方明确请核街名；B：未核午餐价；C：步行路线无查公交安排
